channel.desc: Tray is determined to find out whether he is the father of his ex-girlfriend Tab's baby; she insists that he has been an absentee parent who accuses her of cheating, but she believes he's the one who's been unfaithful; Paul says he has visual and audio proof that girlfriend Ronda is cheating on him right inside their own home; she says she's not cheating and is tired of his outlandish accusations.
